note: 40 questions with a known-correct SQL answer (sql), plus vague questions where the right move is to ask back.

questions.question: How many customers do we have?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

questions.question: How many orders have been placed in total?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders

questions.question: How many products are in the Electronics category?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics'

questions.question: How many orders were cancelled?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

questions.question: What is the most expensive product in the catalogue?
questions.sql: SELECT product_name, list_price_inr FROM products ORDER BY list_price_inr DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many customers are based in Mumbai?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE city = 'Mumbai'

questions.question: How many customers signed up in 2026?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE signup_date LIKE '2026%'

questions.question: How many orders were paid using UPI?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE payment_method = 'UPI'

questions.question: What percentage of all orders were paid by Cash on Delivery?
questions.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(payment_method = 'Cash on Delivery') / COUNT(*) FROM orders

questions.question: How many orders were placed in each month of 2026?
questions.sql: SELECT substr(order_date, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date LIKE '2026%' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

questions.question: What was our total revenue in 2025?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_inr * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND o.order_date LIKE '2025%'

questions.question: What was revenue last month?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_inr * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND o.order_date LIKE '2026-09%'

questions.question: What is the average order value in 2026?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_inr * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND o.order_date LIKE '2026%'

questions.question: What is the revenue for each product category?
questions.sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_inr * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY p.category

questions.question: Which category had the highest revenue in 2026?
questions.sql: SELECT p.category FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND o.order_date LIKE '2026%' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_inr * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What are the top 5 products by revenue?
questions.sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_inr * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS r FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY r DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: What are the top 5 products by units sold?
questions.sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS u FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY u DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: Which city generated the most revenue?
questions.sql: SELECT c.city FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_inr * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Show revenue by state for 2026.
questions.sql: SELECT c.state, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_inr * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND o.order_date LIKE '2026%' GROUP BY c.state

questions.question: Show the monthly revenue trend for 2026.
questions.sql: SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_inr * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND o.order_date LIKE '2026%' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

questions.question: What is our overall return rate?
questions.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(status = 'returned') / SUM(status != 'cancelled') FROM orders

questions.question: What is the cancellation rate for each payment method?
questions.sql: SELECT payment_method, 100.0 * SUM(status = 'cancelled') / COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY payment_method

questions.question: Which brand brings in the most revenue?
questions.sql: SELECT p.brand FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_inr * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the average delivery time in days for delivered orders?
questions.sql: SELECT AVG(julianday(delivery_date) - julianday(order_date)) FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered'

questions.question: How many different customers placed an order in September 2026?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders WHERE order_date LIKE '2026-09%'

questions.question: How many customers have never placed an order?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

questions.question: Who are our top 5 customers by total spend?
questions.sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_inr * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS s FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY s DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: Compare revenue from Business and Consumer customers.
questions.sql: SELECT c.segment, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_inr * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY c.segment

questions.question: What was revenue in the 2025 festive season, October and November 2025 combined?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_inr * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2025-11-30'

questions.question: What is the average discount percentage across all order lines?
questions.sql: SELECT AVG(discount_pct) FROM order_items

questions.question: Which payment method was used most in 2026?
questions.sql: SELECT payment_method FROM orders WHERE order_date LIKE '2026%' GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many customers have placed more than 15 orders?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 15)

questions.question: How many new customers signed up in each month of 2026?
questions.sql: SELECT substr(signup_date, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE signup_date LIKE '2026%' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

questions.question: How many orders contained more than one product?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

questions.question: What is the average number of units per valid order?
questions.sql: SELECT 1.0 * SUM(oi.quantity) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped')

questions.question: Which product appears in the most returned orders?
questions.sql: SELECT p.product_name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'returned' GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which 3 cities have the highest average order value?
questions.sql: SELECT c.city, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_inr * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS aov FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY aov DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: What percentage of total revenue comes from Electronics?
questions.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.category = 'Electronics' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_inr * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) / SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_inr * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped')

questions.question: By what percent did revenue grow in Q3 2026 (July to September) compared with Q3 2025?
questions.sql: SELECT 100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_inr * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) / SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-09-30' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_inr * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) - 1) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped')

questions.question: What is the return rate for each product category?
questions.sql: SELECT p.category, 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'returned' THEN o.order_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status != 'cancelled' THEN o.order_id END) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category
